name: Spinner
purpose: Communicates that an operation is in progress without blocking the UI.
scenarios: Show loading feedback while a form is submitted
Indicate that a remote list is refreshing
Reduce motion when the user prefers it

label.description: Accessible label describing the loading state.

antiPatterns: Do not use as the only loading indicator for long operations without a status message.

a11y.focus: Spinner is not focusable; it is announced via aria-live.
a11y.labeling: An aria-label describes the loading state.

responsive.strategy: Size is token-based; animation respects reduced-motion preferences.

breakpoints.compact: Hit target remains at least the sm size.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Rotation animation is direction-neutral.
